_rulings: AD-26 R-3: films are six — Jijivisha, Wasted, Disposable, Yatra, NatureScapes, Podcasts, as embedded players. R-5: the poster series belongs in Stories, NOT in Publications. Owner, 22 August 2026, on the three blocking questions: Jijivisha is the 'A River Struggles' upload (F_bGH9oFGjA), NOT 'Story of River Yamuna'; Wasted is ONE entry carrying both parts, and 'Waste it' is a different film that gets its own entry; NatureScapes is listed BOTH here and beside the journeys.
_holes: TWO OF THE SIX RULED FILMS HAVE NO SOURCE. AD-26 §4 verified against all 148 indexed videos: 'Disposable' returns zero hits anywhere on the channel, and 'Yatra' is not a film — the only matches are two School Journeys shorts about a Yamuna Yatra. They are named as holes rather than dropped silently, and rather than a sixth title being invented to make the count. DO NOT print a film count that includes them.
_video_source: Every id below is resolved against data/media/youtube-index.json at build time, and the build refuses to write if one is missing. No title is typed here that the channel does not carry.

masthead.lead: The readings are one kind of record. These are the others — films made with the people in them, and a poster series that said the same things on paper, in a city that reads walls before it reads reports.

frame.alt: A large group seated on a hillside slope

films.head: The films
films.lead: Made over two decades, mostly with school and college groups who appear in them. Each plays here; none is behind a form.

entries.title: Jijivisha
entries.subtitle: A river struggles
entries.note: The Yamuna, filmed along the twenty-two kilometres of it that are inside Delhi. Two further uploads of this film exist on the channel; this is the one the film is named by.

entries.title: Wasted
entries.subtitle: In two parts
entries.note: One film, two parts. Both play here in order.

entries.title: Waste it
entries.subtitle: A separate film
entries.note: Named closely enough to Wasted to be mistaken for it, and it is not the same film.

entries.title: NatureScapes
entries.subtitle: A series, not a single film
entries.note: Diary entries filmed on school trips — Sirmaur, Sariska, Ranthambore, Mukteshwar. It is a series, and it also sits beside the journeys it was filmed on.

also_at.label: The journeys these were filmed on

entries._why_title: NOT a playlist. These are filmed on school trips and live inside the School Journeys playlist, so the series is identifiable by title only.

entries.title: Podcasts
entries.subtitle: Conversations, not films

holes: Disposable was asked for and is not on the channel — zero matches across all indexed videos. It is unlisted, elsewhere, or offline, and we have not established which.
Yatra is not a film here. Two short pieces about a Yamuna Yatra exist under the school journeys; if a Yatra film was made, it is somewhere we have not found.

posters.head: The poster series
posters.lead: Drawn by Sandip Paul. They were made to be pasted up, not filed — which is why the titles read like instructions and not like campaign names.

written.head: Written
written.lead: Five essays by people who work here, published as they were written.
written.hole: The illustrations that ran with these essays are not here: they were served from a staging domain that no longer resolves, and carried no alt text.
written._ruling: PUBLISHED, ON THE OWNER'S RULING OF 22 AUGUST 2026: 'publish them. Unsourced data is allowed other than on situation pages.' That reverses the gate added earlier the same day, which refused a story with no source. The reversal is right and the earlier gate was not wrong for what it covered: a situation page is the organisation measuring something and every figure on one is asserted against a committed dataset; an essay is a named person's argument on a date. WHAT IS PUBLISHED IS NOT THE THREE OLD DRAFTS. Those were retired — one made a policy claim AD-17 recorded as unsupported, and the other two were a four-sentence and a two-sentence stub. These are five bylined long-form pieces recovered from the legacy blog, 769-1264 words each, each carrying a name, a date and a link to where it first appeared. Republishing the organisation's own signed writing is a re-host, not a new claim.
written._detail_pages: BUILT, as of 22 August. /stories/<slug> was the pre-design React shell for as long as the three placeholder markdown stories sat behind it; scripts/build-essays.mjs now generates a page per essay in this design, and design-routes.ts maps all five. The note that used to sit here, admitting the route was unported, is gone because the thing it admitted is fixed.

act.head: Bring us a story
act.lead: The films were made with the people in them, and that is the only way we know how to make them.
